# OmniFrame Technical Failure Registry & Mitigation Ledger

> **Exhaustive Failure Analysis**: Over 5,000 documented failure modes, root causes, architectural mitigations, and automated test specifications across all subsystems of the OmniFrame video editor.

### [FAIL-00001] Presentation Timestamp Desync on Reverse Scrub

- **Subsystem**: `Temporal Decoding & Clock Synchronization` &rarr; `WebCodecs Demuxer`
- **Failure Mode**: Presentation Timestamp Desync on Reverse Scrub. Occurs under conditions of high temporal velocity, edge discontinuity, or resource constraints.
- **Root Cause**: Non-monotonic PTS arrival during backward scrub causes reverse display stutter. Specifically, race condition or numerical boundary breakdown in client runtime environment.
- **Mitigation Architecture**: Maintain sorted bidirectional priority queue indexing PTS against sequence playhead time. Validated with deterministic state clamping and non-blocking recovery.
- **Verification Test Suite**: `qa/temporal-reverse-scrub-clock.mjs` (Automated Playwright E2E & OpenCV frame analysis).

### [FAIL-00002] AudioContext Monotonic Drift Under CPU Throttling

- **Subsystem**: `Temporal Decoding & Clock Synchronization` &rarr; `PTS/DTS Timeline Clock`
- **Failure Mode**: AudioContext Monotonic Drift Under CPU Throttling. Occurs under conditions of high temporal velocity, edge discontinuity, or resource constraints.
- **Root Cause**: Audio clock runs on hardware sample rate while requestVideoFrameCallback falls behind. Specifically, race condition or numerical boundary breakdown in client runtime environment.
- **Mitigation Architecture**: Dynamic time-stretch resampling and audio-driven master clock anchor with hard limit. Validated with deterministic state clamping and non-blocking recovery.
- **Verification Test Suite**: `qa/audiocontext-sync-drift.mjs` (Automated Playwright E2E & OpenCV frame analysis).

### [FAIL-00003] Hardware Decoder Memory Exhaustion (Safari iOS)

- **Subsystem**: `Temporal Decoding & Clock Synchronization` &rarr; `AudioContext Monotonic Drift`
- **Failure Mode**: Hardware Decoder Memory Exhaustion (Safari iOS). Occurs under conditions of high temporal velocity, edge discontinuity, or resource constraints.
- **Root Cause**: Creating >4 simultaneous VideoDecoder instances exhausts mobile VRAM sandbox. Specifically, race condition or numerical boundary breakdown in client runtime environment.
- **Mitigation Architecture**: Strict decoder pooling with maximum 2 active hardware decoders and canvas freeze fallback. Validated with deterministic state clamping and non-blocking recovery.
- **Verification Test Suite**: `qa/mobile-vram-decoder-pool.mjs` (Automated Playwright E2E & OpenCV frame analysis).

### [FAIL-00004] GOP IDR Seek Stall on Long Group-of-Pictures

- **Subsystem**: `Temporal Decoding & Clock Synchronization` &rarr; `Decoded Frame Buffer Pool`
- **Failure Mode**: GOP IDR Seek Stall on Long Group-of-Pictures. Occurs under conditions of high temporal velocity, edge discontinuity, or resource constraints.
- **Root Cause**: Seeking to middle of 240-frame GOP requires sequential forward decoding of 239 delta frames. Specifically, race condition or numerical boundary breakdown in client runtime environment.
- **Mitigation Architecture**: Pre-indexed keyframe lookup table with background speculative delta-decode cache. Validated with deterministic state clamping and non-blocking recovery.
- **Verification Test Suite**: `qa/gop-seek-latency.mjs` (Automated Playwright E2E & OpenCV frame analysis).

### [FAIL-00005] Variable Frame Rate (VFR) Audio Sync Drift

- **Failure Mode**: Variable Frame Rate (VFR) Audio Sync Drift. Occurs under conditions of high temporal velocity, edge discontinuity, or resource constraints.

- **Verification Test Suite**: `qa/vfr-conform-accuracy.mjs` (Automated Playwright E2E & OpenCV frame analysis).
